contract.definition: saleLines: Set(SalesLineItem) = self.CurrentSale.ContainedSalesLine, resultingAmount: Real = saleLines->sumBy(line: SalesLineItem | line.Subamount)
contract.precondition: self.CurrentSale.oclIsUndefined() = false and self.CurrentSale.IsComplete = false and self.CurrentSale.IsReadytoPay = false
contract.postcondition: self.CurrentSale.Amount = resultingAmount and self.CurrentSale.IsReadytoPay = true and self.CurrentSale.IsComplete = self.CurrentSale.IsComplete@pre and result = resultingAmount
